versions.changelog:
- Initial release of guaikei-douyin-data-stream skill.
- Provides unified JSON API for Douyin: keyword search, creator content, video comments, and real-time hot topics.
- Automatic intent recognition for short video, Douyin, and trending topic queries (even if "Douyin" not mentioned).
- Clear command structure and parameter inference; up to 10,000 public data records per request.
- Token required via `GUAIKEI_API_TOKEN` with strict error handling; no sensitive or marketing info output on errors.
- All output in plain JSON; includes workflow, error handling, and extensive scenario guidance.
